The '''Meglumine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the site of [[Meglumine]], which was originally an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]].
